`upstream/` contains the complete source archive with only its top-level archive directory removed; source code is unchanged, with the upstream `.gitattributes` text=auto policy permitting Git line-ending normalization on checkout. The official standalone distribution ZIP is unchanged. `licenses/` holds verbatim license/notice/copying entries from the distribution and its nested JARs, preserving artifact names and entry paths; the original entries remain inside the ZIP/JARs.

UMLet is GPL-3.0; the canonical license text is retained in the source/distribution. Its third-party libraries have their own licenses and notices retained by the distribution. The separate local companion uses only the fixed SVG-rendering path, with no browser engine and no custom-code execution. Any companion bridge/adaptations, packaging source selection and source/notice distribution records are described separately; no UMLet code is linked into the Rust application.
